name: LEDGE v2 (tolerance crossing)
metric: r(D) = mean over inference-noise seeds j of the CARE 7-d weighted mean over frames of ||a_D(eps_j) - a_full(eps_j)||_2, first 10 executed steps, all action dims
yardstick: sigma_self = mean over seed pairs (j<l) of the CARE 7-d weighted mean over frames of ||a_full(eps_j) - a_full(eps_l)||_2, same steps and dims
rule: D is predicted safe iff r(D) <= c * sigma_self; along an order, k_safe = (first k with r(prefix_k) > c * sigma_self) - 1
sr_pass_label: closed-loop SR >= anchor - 5 points (pi05 92.25, molmoact2 92.50, smolvla 78.00)
primary_test: ROC-AUC of r(D) for separating fail from pass over all known no-L0 drop sets of a model
secondary_tests: accuracy of the c = 1 rule on the same sets
predicted vs observed k_safe along every order with known SR at two or more k
